card.name: GI after Upper in NSAID warnings
card.fires_on: The abbreviation GI right after the word Upper, at the start of the sentence "Upper GI ulcers, gross bleeding, or perforation" in NSAID gastrointestinal-risk warnings.

modes.label: Upper GI ulcers sentence
modes.description: GI follows a sentence-initial Upper in the NSAID warning about ulcers, bleeding and perforation.
modes.example: Only one in five patients who develop a serious upper GI adverse event on NSAID therapy is symptomatic. Upper<< GI>> ulcers, gross bleeding, or perfor

card.plain: It lights up on the word GI in the stock NSAID warning sentence that begins "Upper GI ulcers, gross bleeding".
